description: Archive notifications for this reader only (your agent, or your key): pass ids, each an item id as list_notifications returns it (at most 100), or all: true to archive everything created up to archive_through (default now). An archived item leaves your list and never counts as unread; list_notifications with view archived shows it, and unarchive_notifications moves it back. Ids that are not in your feed are listed as not found. Answers 404 (not released) until notification archive is switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with notifications write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

all.description: true archives every item created up to archive_through. Send ids or all, not both.

archive_through.description: With all: archive everything created at or before this time, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

ids.description: Notification ids, as list_notifications returns them (such as approval:<uuid>).

name: archive_notifications
